custom_logic_notes: Entry/exit logic is fully encapsulated in CMS_ES_MFI custom signal class from ACMS_ES_MFI.mqh. The EA uses MQL5 Standard Library CExpert framework which manages signal aggregation, position management, and order execution. Signal_ThresholdOpen=40 means the weighted signal must reach 40% to open; Signal_ThresholdClose=20 means 20% to close. Pending orders expire after 4 bars (Signal_Expiration=4). Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated on new bar only, not every tick. The actual MFI vs MA crossover logic and direction mapping (MFI above MA = buy or sell) cannot be determined without reading ACMS_ES_MFI.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: Must read ACMS_ES_MFI.mqh to extract the actual signal logic (MFI crossover with its MA). The CExpert/CExpertSignal framework overhead (signal threshold voting, pending order expiration, position management) must be reimplemented or simplified. CMoneyFixedLot is straightforward - fixed 0.1 lots with 10% margin check. CTrailingNone means no trailing. Key conversion steps: (1) Read ACMS_ES_MFI.mqh for LongCondition/ShortCondition methods, (2) implement MFI(49) and MA-of-MFI(5) indicators, (3) replicate the threshold-based open/close logic (open>=40, close>=20), (4) replicate bar-once evaluation (Expert_EveryTick=false), (5) add 4-bar pending order expiration if pending orders are used. No SL/TP set at EA level - exits are purely signal-driven.
